page.search_description_1: Give to The Friends of Hendricks. A 501(c)(3) nonprofit -- every dollar stays inside Hendricks Avenue Elementary.

section_1.paragraph_1: The Friends of Hendricks is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit. Funds raised through the year are given to Hendricks Avenue Elementary through a grant process — grants that meet the needs the Duval County School Board budget does not cover.

section_2.paragraph_1: Support a student, or give as a gift. Our largest fundraiser, every February.
section_2.paragraph_3: Choose a sponsorship level from $250 to $5,000 and put your name on the shirts, the marquee, and both entrances.
section_2.paragraph_5: Any amount, any time, online through Zeffy.

gift.heading_1: Every dollar stays in this building.
gift.detail_1: Many do, and most people never ask. Contact your employer and ask for your gift to be matched to The Friends of Hendricks, Tax ID 20-4931978.
gift.detail_2: Online learning programs, classroom supplies, teacher professional development, school enhancements, and the leadership curriculum.
gift.note_1: Thank you for your support. Together we are helping our students have the most amazing educational experience.

section_4.paragraph_1: The Friends of Hendricks is run by parent volunteers. What you give is what the school gets, minus nothing.
